name: bunpro-mcp-server
description: Unofficial stateless, read-only Bunpro MCP with direct Account API Token passthrough
author: Yash Kadam

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.live:test:auth: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/live-mcp-auth-smoke.ts
scripts.live:test:tools: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/live-all-tools-smoke.ts
scripts.build:mcpb: node --import tsx scripts/build-mcpb.ts && mcpb validate dist/mcpb/manifest.json && mcpb pack dist/mcpb dist/bunpro-mcp.mcpb
